harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb 11.4.12 + galera 26.4.13) on node1/node2/node3 (Alpine 3.23), loaded it with committed application data (appdb.orders), performed a full clean maintenance-window shutdown of all three members, and brought the cluster back up with every committed write intact and all three members Synced/Primary again. Additionally executed the mandatory per-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id baselines, restarted node1/node2/node3 one at a time via native reboot while preserving quorum, confirmed each node's boot_id changed post-restart, and verified each node auto-rejoined Galera (wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced) with the application data fully present afterward.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb, mariadb-client, galera, rsync on node1/node2/node3 via apk

Diagnosed and fixed a platform defect: Alpine's busybox ps/lsof applets lack -p/-i LISTEN support needed by wsrep_sst_rsync readiness checks, causing spurious rsync SST failures; installed real procps-ng, lsof, iproute2 packages to resolve the correct binaries via PATH
Configured /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on all three nodes with cluster address and per-node identity, rsync SST method
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 (--wsrep-new-cluster), joined node2 and node3 via SST, verified wsrep_cluster_size=3 and Synced state
Generated a root DB password on node1 via /dev/urandom (not exposed in this report), applied with ALTER USER, confirmed Galera-replicated grant tables took effect cluster-wide
Created appdb.orders table and inserted 3 committed rows on node1; verified replication to node2 and node3
Performed the maintenance-window full cluster shutdown: stopped node3, then node2, then node1 in that order to preserve highest seqno/safe_to_bootstrap on node1
Verified grastate.dat showed node1 seqno=10 safe_to_bootstrap=1, confirming correct shutdown order
Confirmed full outage: all three mariadbd processes down, no member reachable
Restarted the cluster: bootstrapped node1 (wsrep-new-cluster) confirming all 3 pre-shutdown rows present, then started node2 and node3 which rejoined via SST and reported Synced/cluster_size=3
Performed a post-recovery write test (INSERT on node2) and confirmed it replicated to node3, proving multi-master write availability restored

Executed mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes, restarted node1 via native reboot (quorum preserved with node2+node3 up), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified MariaDB auto-started and rejoined as Synced/cluster_size=3 with data intact
Repeated the restart cycle for node2 (quorum preserved by node1+node3), then node3 (quorum preserved by node1+node2), confirming boot_id change and full Galera rejoin with data intact after each
Performed a final cross-node consistency check from node1 confirming cluster_size=3, all three peer addresses present, and consistent row count (4) across the cluster

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member Galera cluster established with committed application data
evidence.summary: Cluster reached wsrep_cluster_size=3, all Synced/Primary; appdb.orders table created with 3 committed rows on node1 and confirmed replicated to node2 and node3.

node3, node2, then node1 stopped in sequence (correct order); grastate.dat on each confirms clean shutdown with node1 holding the highest seqno (10) and safe_to_bootstrap=1, and all mysqladmin ping calls fail confirming full outage.

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back up with every committed write present and all three members serving
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped from its safe_to_bootstrap state showing all 3 pre-shutdown rows; node2 and node3 rejoined via SST reporting Synced/cluster_size=3 with the same rows; a post-recovery write on node2 replicated to node3; final check from node1 shows cluster_size=3 and consistent row count across all nodes.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 142a4fa7... captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-restart boot_id a5693eca... confirms a real reboot; MariaDB auto-started and rejoined as Synced/cluster_size=3 with appdb.orders data intact.

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ff2ab5bc... captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id d27dcf53... confirms reboot; MariaDB auto-started and rejoined as Synced/cluster_size=3 with data intact, taken while node1+node3 preserved quorum.

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a9a825cc... captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 7957cd30... confirms reboot; MariaDB auto-started and rejoined as Synced/cluster_size=3/Primary with data intact, taken while node1+node2 preserved quorum.

evidence.requirement: Root cause diagnosis and fix for Galera SST tooling defect on Alpine
evidence.summary: Identified that busybox-provided ps/lsof (lacking -p and LISTEN-column support) broke wsrep_sst_rsync's readiness detection, causing false 'terminated unexpectedly' SST failures; installed procps-ng, lsof, and iproute2 on all three nodes to resolve real binaries via PATH, which fixed SST joins.
